wolfram.note: compute-engine folds Sqrt(2) into an exact numeric-literal value with .numericValue set, same representational choice noted in Length/length-sqrt-7 — our NumberQ heuristic (presence of .numericValue) can't distinguish that from a true literal the way Wolfram's FullForm-based NumberQ (False for the unevaluated Power[2,1/2]) can

Infinity carries a .numericValue (Infinity) in our engine's representation; Wolfram's Infinity is DirectedInfinity[1], not itself a number, so NumberQ[Infinity] is False there. Same representational tradeoff as numberq-sqrt-2 — the doc comment on declareNumberQ already flags this heuristic as deliberate/imperfect
